Display Rulership (Generic Formalwear_Frock Coat_Black)

"Drill the troops," "Secure supply lines," and "Diplomacy"!
Battles aren't only waged on the battlefield!

Her maneuver was breathtakingly brilliant. Compared to myself, who
only focused on the immediate battlefield, the sheer breadth of her vision was...――

Oh, no reinforcements are coming from anywhere.
I've already swayed almost all the influential lords in the surrounding area.

With the conditioning Rulership has achieved with this plan,
she will surely claim a glorious victory in the upcoming selection race.
True, you possess overwhelming numbers. But—are numbers really everything?

Indeed, she certainly showed remarkable promise.
...The school she attended was run by my mother—

...Did you know she attended a racing academy
before enrolling in Tracen Academy?

Have you considered her nutrition? If you want to build stamina while facilitating
fatigue recovery, you'll need vitamin B1, iron, zinc, and of course, protein.

............No way.
I'm so done losing at trash games...

Flawless analysis, a flawless roadmap.
Alongside diverse situational forecasts and strategies tailored to each.

In essence, it boils down to: "If it's a game she can win, she finds it fun and gets motivated,
but if it's unwinnable, she loses all interest."

Her talent is truly the real deal. With a conscious strategic mindset,
she can "master the race before it even begins."

How about playing this today? It's a new medieval strategy sim.
Board game enthusiasts have been praising it for its deep strategic depth.

Considering the roster, the course... and all the variables,
with this level of preparation, victory should be guaranteed. —What do you think?

It's a competitive game based on the Hundred Years' War.
Let's have you defend as the French army, while I invade as the English forces.

Possessing such extraordinary potential, paired with an exceptionally rare intellect,
Rulership should have thrived. And yet—

However, I've deliberately left parts unfinished. With this...
I intend to test Rulership's analytical capabilities!
Of course I am! Because it's a strategy perfectly devised by none other than me!

An army isn't simply about gathering massive numbers.
A unit's true worth comes down to its "discipline and training."

I'll muster three times that amount. Summoning the knights and hiring mercenaries!
Above all, the battlefield is on home turf... I should hold the tactical advantage.

First off, this schedule is way too packed. I get that time
is limited, but morale will crumble at this rate. So—

Without revealing that it's meant for Rulership,
I share the data. The target is a 2000m turf selection race.

My army, which should have held overwhelming numbers,
is somehow being steadily backed into a corner...!!

Heh—will your provisions really last?
I've reduced the surrounding granaries to ash. You'll have no choice but to haul supplies from outside.

Ruling the competition not just through split-second tactics, but through overarching "grand strategy"—
isn't that precisely the greatest weapon she can bring to a race?

...Looked at from another angle, couldn't one deduce this?
"As long as she can win, there's a way to rekindle her motivation."

I see. You want me to polish it from a strategic perspective, right?
Well, that's my forte, so sure, why not.

—The next day. I put together a roadmap.
One with the sole objective of "Securing Rulership's victory in the selection race."
『A roadmap? Hmph... For your trainee Umamusume?』

The reason Ruler wants to slack off?
Nothing complicated—she's simply sulking.

How can I get Rulership to win consistently and hit her stride—
Pondering this, I find myself on a voice call with her during another online game...
Crush them into dust!!

『The Hundred Years' War—a prolonged conflict spanning over a century,
sparked by territorial disputes and claims to the French throne. The stage: France—』
Well, we'll see about that.

............Fine, I'll give it a shot.
I have to prove that my strategy is flawless, after all...!

That's how it is. That blockhead
simply has a temperament that makes sustaining motivation remarkably difficult...

Tracen Academy is a gathering of the exceptionally gifted.
Her little tactics won't work every single time.

When she won, she won. But whenever a tactic failed to land, it ended in crushing defeat.
...She couldn't stand that. So she started throwing fits and sulking—

She was sharp-witted and her running was extraordinary. She swept through her races with ease—
which was why she enjoyed it. ...However, the world isn't so forgiving, is it?

Right now, she's completely lost her drive to race... Letting things stay
this way would be such a waste. How can I rekindle her passion?
You are utterly isolated and without aid———— It's over.

Huh? A late start...? Wait a second, this data............
――――Wait, could this possibly be...

—Also, training intensity should follow standard opening theory by ramping up gradually.
Focus strictly on stamina and explosive burst, avoiding unnecessary fatigue.
